independent_output_verification.scope: Full persisted statistics and all 8 candidates; all 14 reviewed groups independently recounted from existing complete raw-group fixtures with actual production producer. No second full raw-source count pass.
independent_output_verification.clean_max_scope: Independently reduced every persisted checkpoint and verified max(all)=max(clean, independently recounted flagged) on every pair; did not recount all clean ORCID groups from source.
independent_output_verification.candidate_semantics: ORCID count >= threshold wins unchanged; alias count >= 2 supplies only missing keys; alias counts are not added or maximized.

validation_comparison.capacity_bound_definition: For each gold cluster of n signatures within a block: q*C(C-1)/2+r(r-1)/2, where (q,r)=divmod(n,C). Sum across clusters and blocks. This is an upper bound, not a feasible joint packing guarantee.
validation_comparison.partition_comparison: SHA256 of sorted groups of sorted actual member IDs, independent of native subblock names

reference_lookup_verification.reference_policy: Historical directional raw artifact under current Rust lexicographic-direction-first, then reverse-fallback lookup. This is not a recovered canonical release artifact or an original historical-consumer replay.
reference_lookup_verification.proof_scope: Every stored unordered key checked in both query directions; queries outside this union return None under both maps because no stored key is introduced or dropped.
reference_lookup_verification.partition_parity: Pending independent validation harness; lookup equivalence alone is established here.

limitations: Validation uses reconstructed current-policy membership, not a recovered historical release split.
The reference uses historical counts with the current Rust consumer; the canonical packaged prior is absent.
All selected blocks are below 4000 signatures; 100/250/500 are stress settings.
No model was trained or scored; this measures subblocking gold-pair retention and comparison cost.
No production publication or automatic quarantine was performed.
Scratch scripts and prerequisite inputs are local/gitignored; see the companion reproduction notes.
